use_case_name: Generate Treatment Quality and Trend Reports

claims.content: To generate standard and customized reports on treatment quality, claim collection, and provider performance for analysis and decision-making.

goal.raw_text: To generate standard and customized reports on treatment quality, claim collection, and provider performance for analysis and decision-making.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The user must have entered correct Voucher No for treatment data to be auto-populated and available for reporting.
The system must have completed claim collection cycles, as reports are generated monthly after claim collection on clean claims or withheld claims.
Mandatory master-level information (Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs, Other Measures) must be entered into the system during claim entry, except Contact No.
The VSP staff must have recorded thumb impression from the patient and stuck the voucher slip on the claim form, as system only accepts claims if mandatory information is complete.
Treatment Form No and Claim No must be generated or entered — Claim No is auto-generated with Hospital Code suffix + 8 digits; Treatment Form No lists unentered claim receipt details.
The MSIU Field Office User initiates the generation of treatment quality and trend reports after monthly claim collection cycles are completed, as required by the 'Programme Design Study' document.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the generation of treatment quality and trend reports after monthly claim collection cycles are completed, as required by the 'Programme Design Study' document.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the report generation process after monthly claim collection cycles are completed, as required by the 'Programme Design Study' document.

The system retrieves treatment data automatically populated from the system based on Voucher No, including Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated information.
The system generates a monthly report after claim collection on clean claims to be paid without reservation.
The system generates a monthly report after claim collection on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
The system generates a report on claims per provider.
The system presents the generated standard and customized reports to the MSIU Field Office User for analysis and decision-making.

If mandatory information is missed or false information exists in the claim form, the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and keep those claims in a quarantine area, which may affect report generation until verification and re-entry.

Quarantined forms sent back to VSP for verification — if VSP returns satisfactory details, claims are entered into the system in the following month’s batch, delaying their inclusion in current reports.
The user must not alter any treatment information that auto-populates from the system based on Voucher No; if altered, it may compromise data integrity for reports.

If any mandatory information is missed or false information exists in the claim form during data entry, the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and keep those claims in a quarantine area — this may prevent accurate report generation until verification and re-entry.
Quarantined forms sent back to VSP for verification — if VSP does not return satisfactory details, claims remain excluded from current month’s batch and thus from associated reports.
If the user alters any treatment information that auto-populates from the system based on Voucher No, it may compromise data integrity required for generating valid quality and trend reports.
During submission entry, if any mandatory information (other than Contact No) is missing, the system will not accept the claim — resulting in incomplete dataset for report generation.
If Date of Submission is not current date during Claim (Treatment Form) Submission, the system may flag or reject the transaction, affecting timeliness and accuracy of monthly reports.
The system has generated and presented a monthly report after claim collection on clean claims to be paid without reservation.
The system has generated and presented a monthly report after claim collection on claims where payment shall be withheld until clarification.
The system has generated and presented a report on claims per provider.

Treatment quality data including Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated information — all auto-populated from the system based on Voucher No — are accurately reflected in the generated reports.
Claims that were quarantined due to missing or false mandatory information remain excluded from current reports until verified by VSP and re-entered in a subsequent batch.
